title.narrative: Stepping Up Universal Access: A Multi-Sectoral Partnership Response to TB/HIV - Lesotho (01-Jul-2021-31-Mar-2024)

description.narrative: Lesotho, TB/HIV, Ministry of Finance of the Kingdom of Lesotho (MOF)This program has the following goals: Reduced HIV incidence by at least 75% by 2023 from 2018 baseline. Reduced AIDS related deaths by 50% by 2023 from a baseline of 2018. Mother to child transmission of HIV reduced to below 5% by 2023. To reduce the overall mortality of TB by 75% by 2022. To reduce the overall incidence of TB by 50% by 2022. The objectives of this program are: To Fast Track Test and Treat Cascade to attain 95-95-95 targets by 2023. To achieve 95% access to combination prevention by 2023. To Eliminate Mother to Child Transmission and have 95% of children living with HIV on treatment by 2023. To remove Gender and Human Rights Related Barriers to service delivery, accessibility and utilization by 2023. To ensure that at least 30% of the HIV/TB response is community-led and sustained by 2023. To ensure that Health System is people-centered, and sustainably integrates HIV, TB, and other infections by 2023. To find 90% of all incident TB cases and place cases notified on appropriate treatment by 2022. To treat successfully 90% of all drug-susceptible TB patients, irrespectively of their HIV status by 2022. To find 90% of the incident drug-resistant TB cases, place all of them on appropriate treatment and successfully treat 75% of them, irrespectively of their HIV status by 2022. To increase the workload capacity of the TB laboratory services to more than 67 000 Xpert MTB/RIF tests per year
